name: DAYDREAMER
source:
DAYDREAMER is A slow-burn slice of life, linear kinetic Visual Novel about friendship, family and the trouble that starts when daydreams won’t stay quiet.

This is a story driven ADULT VN that focuses on world building and character relationships.

Meet a tight household, an old friend, and a teacher he shouldn’t be thinking about.
